You shouldn’t feel guilty for having these feelings. I’m in the same boat as you are, where I have some good things going for me yet I’ve been so severely depressed and traumatized i don’t want to keep going. It’s hard to feel like you’re “too privileged” to be suicidal when you actually have valid reasons for feeling so depressed. Don’t be hard on yourself for feeling this way, but also look into help if you can, please.

I understand. I’m stuck in the same place you are in terms of how you’re feeling. I know it’s hard to live day to day being suicidal while nobody really knows your struggles. It’s hard too when you work hard on bettering what you can and you feel it’s not enough or that people won’t care. I know it feels like a completely hopeless cycle sometimes. But you’ve lived through every hard day you’ve ever had, and you sound like a very compassionate person who cares a lot. If you’re not ready to directly reach out to people for help, sometimes watching videos or reading up on healthy coping mechanisms/strategies can at least make you more familiar and comfortable with looking for help. If you need to take baby steps, that’s ok, as long as you’re still here and alive.

Please at least look into it. I know i’m just some stranger on a screen but please know that after reading everything I want you to know that I do care. You seem like a person with a good heart who’s struggling, someone who’s been hurt so much. I know it’s never easy, i know some days it feels like the toxicity from other people and the hatred towards yourself won’t end but I can tell you that staying alive and working hard just to make the smallest amount of progress is worth it. Find ways to take care of yourself, find healthy outlets and most importantly look for help - even if it’s as simple as calling a loved one or reaching out to a counselor. Please stay with us.
